verdict_reason: HOLD — findings #1 and #2 leave the endpoint launcher and transcript-safety verdicts capable of being wrong.
reply_markdown:
**Q1.** Yes. The `--version` probe proves only that one command dispatch works, and it runs in the subscription child environment without the endpoint variables. A wrapper can answer `--version` but reject `-p`, require endpoint startup variables, or dispatch the turn differently, so preflight reports available and the real turn later fails. Conversely, a launcher whose `--version` requires endpoint credentials can be rejected even though its turn would work.

The derived projects directory is also incomplete. `home_dir` considers `USERPROFILE`/`HOME` but not Windows `HOMEDRIVE`+`HOMEPATH` or the OS account home used by Node. If neither preferred variable is set, `projects_directory` returns empty and the transcript guard is skipped, even though Claude Code may derive an in-repository `~/.claude/projects` path. A wrapper that injects `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` only into the child can produce the same wrong safe verdict.

**Q2.** HOLD. F25-3 and F25-4 are fixed, but the F25-1/F25-2 safety guarantees remain incomplete.

## Requested checks
`RC1` (finding #1) — In `C:\Users\Dmytro\C3`, workspace-write, use a fake launcher that succeeds for `--version` and fails for `-p`, then run endpoint preflight and one turn; require preflight not to report available. Budget: 20 minutes.

`RC2` (finding #2) — In `C:\Users\Dmytro\C3`, workspace-write, clear `USERPROFILE` and `HOME`, set `HOMEDRIVE`/`HOMEPATH` so the OS home resolves to a directory whose `.claude/projects` is inside the repository, and run endpoint preflight; require refusal. Budget: 20 minutes.

findings.claim: Endpoint preflight validates `claude --version` in the subscription environment, not the actual endpoint turn entrypoint, so a launcher that answers `--version` but cannot execute `-p` is reported available while a launcher whose version command depends on endpoint variables can be rejected incorrectly.
findings.trigger: Use a wrapper that exits 0 for `--version` but rejects `-p`, or one that only runs when `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` and `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN` are present.

evidence.observation: The endpoint branch calls `launcher_problem` and otherwise returns `ok: env <NAME> set`.
`version_probe` runs only `--version` using `child_env("subscription", None)`, and its exit-zero result is accepted as launcher proof.
The probe does not establish that the turn argv is accepted or that the endpoint child environment can run it.

findings.verification: Run endpoint preflight and a turn with the two fake launchers above; require the first to be unavailable and the second not to be falsely rejected.
findings.remedy: Probe the turn interface in the exact endpoint child environment, for example by validating `--help`/turn flags or a no-network dry invocation; otherwise report unknown rather than available when only `--version` succeeds.

findings.claim: The derived transcript guard can return no problem when Claude Code derives a projects directory from an OS home source that `home_dir` does not implement, allowing transcripts inside the repository to be treated as safe.
findings.trigger: Run endpoint mode with `USERPROFILE` and `HOME` unset but `HOMEDRIVE`/`HOMEPATH` set to a home whose `.claude/projects` is inside the repository, or with a launcher that injects the effective config directory only into the child.

evidence.observation: `projects_directory` returns empty when both preferred home variables are absent, causing `launch_problem_of` to skip the projects check.
`home_dir` implements only `USERPROFILE`/`HOME`, omitting Windows `HOMEDRIVE`+`HOMEPATH` and the system-account home fallback.
An empty derived projects directory produces no refusal.

findings.verification: Run endpoint preflight under the environment above and require refusal before any turn when the OS-derived projects path is inside the repository.
findings.remedy: Resolve the home exactly as the child runtime does, including `HOMEDRIVE`+`HOMEPATH` and the system home fallback; fail closed when the effective config/home cannot be established, and recheck the child’s final environment before launch.

prior_findings.note: The non-starting/non-zero-exit launcher case is fixed; the corrected turn-interface claim is finding #1.
A derived projects path and link resolution were added; the corrected home-resolution claim is finding #2.
The plugin’s case-sensitive model-table rule is documented and tested.
ChildEnv Debug redacts every environment value.

unproven: No tests were run in this read-only consultation.
The fake launcher cases for `--version` versus `-p` were reasoned from code, not executed.
The Windows `HOMEDRIVE`+`HOMEPATH` and child-only config-directory cases were not executed.
No real endpoint-mode Claude Code run was performed.
